security_justification.audit_integrity: Event identity, byte-identical occurrence copies and consumer deduplication constrain evidence integrity. Future raw results remain separate from immutable expectations; this proposal claims no measured integrity outcome.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: The profile forbids failed-authentication targets and scopes non-disclosure to first-factor failures. Each future run requires its own exact-head owner comment; proposal review grants no run permission.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Published policy trust is distinguished from actual host value origin. SDK branding is not attestation, and future carrier observations must record provenance ambiguity independently of acceptance.
security_justification.concurrency: Future P-ids compares fresh processes and restarts, and P-E distinguishes in-memory handles from durable host transactions. The future orchestrator serializes fresh processes under preplanned budgets; fixture tests exercise only isolated synthetic state without importing SDK code.
security_justification.confidentiality: Only synthetic opaque identifiers and documentation-range addresses may be used; prohibited markers are confined to P-D. Secrets, bearer values and presented login identifiers remain excluded from emitted evidence.
security_justification.cryptography: The design uses memory-only per-run keys and host-computed session fingerprints under shared chain scope. Current fixed core and Node cryptographic UUID sources satisfy the event-ID obligation; no key material is created here.
security_justification.error_disclosure: First-factor outcome reasons, failure reasons, messages and resource content must not disclose account existence. Targetless second-factor and lockout reasons remain allowed per G36; future refusals are recorded without invented codes.
security_justification.external_security_integration: Bloodtrail supplies evidence only; external consumers own enrichment, detection, scoring and fraud verdicts. Future probes use the packed kit as an outside-repository own service and loopback-only exchanges.
security_justification.fail_posture: Non-synthetic data or a critical security defect halts and reports. Expectation mismatches are findings, not silently corrected thresholds. Any out-of-scope gate failure stops this proposal rather than bypassing enforcement.
security_justification.lifecycle: The proposed seven-day window opens at the first owner run-approval comment, with shared ten-run limits. Expiry requires amendment through the change; Stage 2 waits for owner review and separate authorization.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: This change owns planning files and each exact harness/expectations/test path in its directory, no package implementation. Task 1.1 performs only one clean-tree build/install dry run; probes await S1. Fold, archive, ADR and profile documents are deferred tickets; canonical contract fields remain untouched.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Exact observed address and direct internal opaque account IDs require recorded purpose exceptions. Session fingerprints are host-computed, not per-event hook outputs; real-user exact-address use requires a DPIA.
security_justification.resource_retention: The owner holds data, retention and key roles. Future kit, harness-local synthetic database and logs are deleted at run end, including stops; committed synthetic evidence is separate from disposable scratch.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: P-E will count probe and commit-gate invocations across k=3 fail-closed redeliveries and new instances. Persistent retry and host atomicity are hypotheses to measure, not guarantees supplied by this proposal.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Only public-call outcomes, the core sink and injected handoff exchange are observation boundaries; the latter is fixture-only for P-ids. Trusted-hop extraction and host fact truth remain host responsibilities; structural acceptance never upgrades client claims to authority.
